hooks.command: unset BUN_OPTIONS NODE_OPTIONS; for n in $(env | sed -n 's/^\(BUN_CONFIG_[A-Za-z0-9_]*\|BUN_INSPECT[A-Za-z0-9_]*\)=.*/\1/p'); do unset "$n"; done; f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/.agents/local/hooks/event.js"; export VULCAN_HOOK_FILE="$f" VULCAN_HOOK_ROOT="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; if [ -f "$f" ] && command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun --no-env-file --config=/dev/null -e 'const fs = require("node:fs"), cp = require("node:child_process"), c = require("node:crypto"), os = require("node:os"), path = require("node:path"); const f = process.env.VULCAN_HOOK_FILE ?? "", root = process.env.VULCAN_HOOK_ROOT ?? "", name = f.split("/").pop() ?? ""; let want; try { const g = cp.spawnSync("git", ["--no-replace-objects", "-C", root, "show", "HEAD:./.agents/vulcan.manifest.json"], { encoding: "utf8", timeout: 10000, env: { ...process.env, GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS: "1" } }); const m = JSON.parse(g.stdout); const s = m && m.hooks && m.hooks.sha256; want = s && typeof s[name] === "string" ? s[name] : undefined; } catch {} let bytes, got; try { bytes = fs.readFileSync(f); got = c.createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex"); } catch {} if (want === undefined || want !== got) { console.error("vulcan: the hook " + name + " is not the one the manifest at HEAD records (hooks.sha256), or there is no git or no committed manifest: the owner runs bun node_modules/.bin/vulcan sync and commits the manifest, outside the agent session"); process.exit(97); } const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "vulcan-hook-")); const copy = path.join(dir, name); process.on("exit", () => { try { fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); } catch {} }); fs.writeFileSync(copy, bytes, { mode: 0o600 }); await import(copy);'; fi; exit 0
